name: Microsoft AutoGen
description: Microsoft's pioneering multi-agent conversation framework, now in maintenance mode.
descriptionZh: 微软的多 Agent 对话框架先驱，现已进入维护模式。
keyFact: Microsoft AutoGen entered maintenance mode on 2 October 2025: it receives only bug and security fixes with no new features, and Microsoft directs new projects to Microsoft Agent Framework, which reached 1.0 GA in April 2026; the community fork AG2 continues independently under Apache-2.0.
keyFactZh: Microsoft AutoGen 于 2025 年 10 月 2 日进入维护模式：仅接收缺陷与安全修复、不再新增功能，微软引导新项目转向 2026 年 4 月 GA 的 Microsoft Agent Framework；社区分支 AG2 则以 Apache-2.0 独立演进。
caveat: Maintenance mode since October 2025 — no new features. Not a starting point for new projects.
caveatZh: 自 2025 年 10 月起处于维护模式，不再新增功能；不建议新项目采用。
